```python
import math   # Importing Math Library for Square Root & Cube Root Calculations
num = int(input("Enter a Number: "))    # Taking user input of the numbers to calculate square root and cube roots; change it accordingly based on what you want from this code. 16,9 or any other number can be given as an example for understanding purposes in python programming language how these calculations are performed
print("Square Root: ", math.sqrt(num))    # Printing the square root of inputted numbers using sqrt() function provided by Math Library; change it accordingly based on what you want from this code 8,2 or any other number can be given as an example for understanding purposes in python programming language
print("Cube Root: ", math.cbrt(num))    # Printing the cube root of inputted numbers using cbrt() function provided by Math Library; change it accordingly based on what you want from this code 2,3 or any other number can be given as an example for understanding purposes in python programming language
```
